Inglewood, California
  July 16, 2024

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
July 16, 2024, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

MAYOR PRO-TEM APPOINTMENT. It was moved by Council Member Faulk, and
seconded by Council Member Padilla that the City Council does hereby appoint Council
Member Morales as Mayor Pro Tem for Closed Session. The motion was carried by the
following roll call vote:
Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk;
Noes: None; and
Absent: Mayor Butts.

Mayor Pro Tem Morales called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:01
p.m.

The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Pro Tem
  Morales;
  Absent: Mayor Butts.

City officials and personnel present for Closed Session were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Mark F. Weinberg  City Manager
  Rick R. Olivarez  City Attorney
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Pro Tem
Morales inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council
on the Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1, CS-2, CS-3, and CS-4.

There was no response.

Mayor Pro Tem Morales recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:01 p.m. for Closed
Session Item Nos. CS-1, CS-2, CS-3, and CS-4.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Pro Tem Morales
called the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing
Authority at the hour of 2:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members Gray, Padilla, Faulk; and Mayor Pro
  Tem/Successor Agency Chairman Pro Tem/Housing
  Authority Chairman Pro Tem Morales; and
  Absent:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Mark F. Weinberg  City Manager/ Executive Director*
  Rick R. Olivarez  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.
 July 16, 2024

133  COMMENDATION – DR. MARLO NICOLE RICHARDSON. The City Council
  presented Dr. Marlo Nicole Richardson with a Commendation for her outstanding
  academic achievement in receiving her Doctorate Degree in Business and Entrepreneurship
  from Harvest Christian University.

142.9  PAYMENT WARRANTS AND BILLS – RECEIVED AND FILED. The demands
  presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated July 12, 2024, in
  the amount of $7,229,656.93, are hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/Successor Agency
  Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify upon said registers
  that said demands are received and filed.

  Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency Chairman Pro Tem /Housing Authority Chairman Pro
  Tem Morales ordered the Warrants and Bills received and filed.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency
  Chairman Pro Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem Morales inquired if there were
  any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority on any item on the Agendas other than the Public Hearing,

  Speaker (Name Unknown) spoke concerning a matter not on the Agenda and was advised
  to comment towards the end of the meeting to address his concern.

142  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – RESOLUTION NO. 24-103 ADOPTED –
  PLACEMENT OF DELINQUENT SEWER AND REFUSE CHARGES ON THE
  TAX ROLLS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-2024. The City Clerk announced that the next
  scheduled matter was a public hearing to consider adoption of a resolution, making findings,
  overruling protests and objections, and ordering delinquent sewer fees and refuse charges
  to be placed on the tax rolls for Fiscal Year 2023-2024, and that notices were given in the
  time, form and manner as required by law, an affidavit was on file, and communications
  were received and distributed to the Mayor Pro Tem and Council Members.

  The City Clerk, Aisha L. Thompson, received communications via email from Anonymous,
  who opposed the placement of delinquent sewer and refuse charges on the tax rolls for Fiscal
  Year 2023-2024.

  Mayor Pro Tem Morales ordered the communications received and filed.

  Mark F. Weinberg, City Manager, presented a Staff Report dated July 16, 2024.

  Sharon Kioke, Finance Director, presented a brief oral presentation.

  Mayor Pro Tem Morales inquired if there were any persons present that wished to address
  the City Council on this matter.

  There was no response.

  Mayor Pro Tem Morales closed the public comment portion at the hour of 2:08 p.m.

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  Resolution No. 24-103 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, MAKING FINDINGS, OVERRULING PROTESTS AND
  OBJECTIONS, AND ORDERING DELINQUENT SEWER AND REFUSE
  CHARGES TO BE PLACED ON THE TAX ROLLS PURSUANT TO HEALTH
  AND SAFETY CODE SECTION 5470 ET SEQ.

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Gray, Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Pro Tem Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Mayor Butts.

  2
 July 16, 2024

  COUNTY/DACC SERVICE RATE ADJUSTMENTS. Staff report dated July 16, 2024,

  with the County of Los Angeles Department of Animal Care and Control (County/DACC)
  to renew services from July 1, 2024, to June 30, 2029, at a first-year cost not to exceed
